pow.independentHelp: Saving gives this independent policy control of the site. Legacy WAF PoW nodes are skipped; other WAF rules continue to run.
pow.difficultyHelp: Each difficulty increment increases expected work by about 16 times. The progress bar is a probability estimate.
pow.pathHelp: Matches the normalized path without its query string. Matching is case-sensitive. Allowlist matches take precedence and other protections continue to run.
pow.whitelistHelp: Any matching entry bypasses PoW, such as static assets, health checks or webhooks.
pow.blacklistHelp: Add at least one entry in blocklist mode. Not required in all-paths mode.
pow.saved: PoW policy saved and queued for automatic sync to edge nodes.
pow.pageHelp: Page layouts are independent of the verification runtime. Built-in templates can be customized.
pow.templateHelp: Empty custom HTML uses the selected style. Load a template into the editor to customize it.
pow.pageSaved: Challenge page saved and queued for automatic sync to edge nodes.
pow.htmlTooLarge: Custom HTML must not exceed 256 KiB
pow.customHelp: Insert {widget} for the verification widget and {host} for the hostname. The runtime is injected automatically. Custom interfaces can listen to openflare:pow state events.
pow.previewHelp: The preview simulates verification states. Live visits perform PoW computation.
pow.previewStatus: Please wait while we check your connection…
pow.previewProtected: Connection verification powered by OpenFlare PoW protection.
pow.previewWhyDescription: Your browser completes a computation to help the site identify automated abuse. Your visit continues automatically afterward.
pow.previewNoscript: Enable JavaScript and reload this page.
pow.legacyLink: Configure protection in the rule details PoW tab
pow.unconfiguredHelp: No independent policy has been saved. Existing WAF PoW nodes still apply. Saving gives these controls ownership of the site’s PoW protection.
